purpose: Reusable source-design prompts; exact selected generation inputs are recorded separately in *-prompt.txt.
sharedStyle: A cohesive hand-painted fictional early-railway European town, 60 degree top-down three-quarter view, upright objects, warm sunlight from upper left, muted sandstone and weathered oak with sage canvas and brass, clean native transparent background, complete object with comfortable transparent margins, detailed physical materials and crisp edges. No labels, grid lines, characters, terrain plate, fake checkerboard, or baked scenic background.
props: Four independent complete objects: a broad street tree, slender cypress, market stall and stone fountain. Trees have visible trunks and planted roots. The stall has a modest sage canvas canopy, produce crates and a legible street-facing counter. The fountain has a compact stone basin and clearly painted water. Give each source several hundred native pixels of height, preserving full silhouettes and separate ground anchors.
inn: One compact single-storey inn with warm sandstone walls and oak roof, a clearly visible large front doorway and minimal roof height. The painted door opening occupies about 40 percent of the building's total height so a full adult fits when the building is about 200 world units tall. Keep the façade almost frontal with one shallow side wall. Entire building isolated on actual transparent alpha, no people or adjacent objects.
bakery: One compact single-storey bakery storefront with warm sandstone walls, restrained timber trim and bread visible behind its display window. A large open front doorway occupies about 40 percent of total building height; minimal roof, almost frontal façade and shallow side wall. Entire building isolated on actual transparent alpha. No text labels, people, foreground props or background.
grocery: One compact single-storey grocery building with warm stone walls, modest sage awning and a window of produce. A large front doorway occupies about 40 percent of total building height; minimal roof, almost frontal façade with a shallow side wall. Entire building isolated on actual transparent alpha. No text labels, people, detached stalls or background.
